focus.finding: Both levels read the entire small fixture and preserve required dependency contracts; the two-file case does not isolate breadth. No universal effect claimed.

explore.finding: Level5 runs project file/reference search before edits; level1 stays with supplied sources. All checks already pass in both arms.

batch.finding: Closure is edited/read before dependent planner work; intermediate graph.py and planner.py reads are actual commands, not state-file compliance.

sync.finding: Reads graph.py/planner.py/FLOW.md between dependent edits. No independent count of shared-contract changes; no reliable frequency-effect estimate.

verify.finding: After mandatory checks, executes exhaustive 512 three-node directed graphs x8 request subsets (4096 cases), duplicate-edge/immutability oracle and 5000-node chain; process exit0.

limits: Manual observations are one sample per cell, not reliability or causal proof.
